items.distractor_fact: A meteorológus saját házának hőmérője ugyanezen a reggelen {D} fokot mutatott.
items.gloss_en: The meteorologist's own house thermometer showed {D} degrees that same morning.
items.entity_note: owner is a person's private instrument (the meteorologist's home thermometer), not another town as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Az egyik kereskedő ugyanezen a napon zárásban {D} dollár értékű részvényt tartott a portfóliójában.
items.gloss_en: One trader held, at that same day's close, {D} dollars' worth of stock in his portfolio.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a trader's portfolio), not another traded product as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Egy horgász a saját mérőbotjával egy másik tavon ugyanazon a hétvégén {D} métert mért.
items.gloss_en: An angler, with his own measuring rod, measured {D} meters at a different lake that same weekend.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (an angler with his own gauge), not another lake itself as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik pilóta drónja ugyanezen a napon {D} méter magasságban repült.
items.gloss_en: Another pilot's drone flew at a height of {D} meters that same day.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a different pilot who owns the drone), not the drone itself as an unowned object as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik ügyfél csomagja feladáskor {D} kilogramm volt.
items.gloss_en: Another customer's package weighed {D} kilograms at shipping.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a different customer), not the package itself as an unowned object as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: A helyi iskola tanulóinak létszáma ugyanabban az évben {D} fő volt.
items.gloss_en: The local school's number of students was {D} persons in that same year.
items.entity_note: owner is an organisation (the local school's own headcount), not another settlement as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: A közúti sebességmérő kamera egy másik szakaszon {D} kilométer per órás sebességet mért.
items.gloss_en: The road speed camera measured a speed of {D} kilometers per hour on a different stretch.
items.entity_note: owner is an instrument (a speed camera), not another car as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik ügyfél ugyanabban a hónapban {D} eurót fizetett be egy másik bankfióknál.
items.gloss_en: Another customer paid in {D} euros at a different bank branch that same month.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a different customer at a different branch), not another savings account as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Egy vállalat ugyanabban a hónapban {D} forintos bevételt könyvelt el.
items.gloss_en: A company booked revenue of {D} forints in that same month.
items.entity_note: owner is an organisation (a company), not another household as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: A liga legjobb gólszerzője a szezonban {D} gólt szerzett.
items.gloss_en: The league's top scorer scored {D} goals in the season.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (an individual player's personal tally), not another team as in the first distractor

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik exportmegrendelés keretében ugyanabban a hónapban {D} darabot szállítottak ki.
items.gloss_en: Under a different export order, {D} units were shipped out in that same month.
items.entity_note: owner is a separate order/contract (a series), not another factory as in the first distractor; that order carries no stated plan, so the story's target does not apply to it

items.distractor_fact: A meteorológiai szolgálat egy másik mérőállomásán ugyanazon a napon {D} milliméter csapadékot mértek.
items.gloss_en: At a different measuring station of the meteorological service, {D} millimeters of rainfall were measured that same day.
items.entity_note: owner is an instrument/station run by an organisation, not another settlement as in the first distractor; that station's own forecast is not stated, so the story's forecast does not apply to it

items.distractor_fact: Egy másik golfpálya legjobb eredménye {D} ütés volt.
items.gloss_en: The best result at a different golf course was {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: owner is a place (a different course), not another player on another hole as in the first distractor; that course's own par is not stated, so the story's par does not apply to it

items.distractor_fact: Egy utas saját órája szerint a szomszédos peronon egy másik szerelvény a(z) {D}. percben futott be.
items.gloss_en: According to a passenger's own watch, a different train arrived at the {D}th minute on the neighbouring platform.
items.entity_note: owner is a person (a passenger's own timing of a different train), not another train's own line and timetable as in the first distractor
